set.StepText: Talk to Iesia in Droighaid; tell her [Sandu sent] you. (whisper: Sandu sent)|Talk to Eersie in Necht; tell her [Iesia sent] you. (whisper: Iesia sent)|Kill what Eersie names (a soaring manta for its tail).|Give the part to Evyene on the beach behind Necht and tell her you [seek a cure].|Get a tentacle from a death shroud in World's End.|Get blood from a chalico near the death shrouds.|Seek out Xcrzrk outside Krrzck and tell her [Evyene sent] you (or kill her for the egg). (whisper: Evyene sent)|Give Evyene the tentacle, blood and egg.|Give Iesia the potion when she asks.|Drink some of the potion.|Give the potion to Cailbyn east outside Droighaid.|Give the note to Sandu and choose two rings.|Choose your first ring: whisper Sandu the name of the ring you want (Holly Ring, Willow Wood Ring, Heather Ring, Aspen Wood Ring, Hawthorn Wood Ring, Hazel Wood Ring, Rowen Wood Ring, Silver Fir Wood Ring, Alder Wood Ring, Yew Wood Ring, Ash Wood Ring).|Choose your second ring, a different one: whisper Sandu its name (Holly Ring, Willow Wood Ring, Heather Ring, Aspen Wood Ring, Hawthorn Wood Ring, Hazel Wood Ring, Rowen Wood Ring, Silver Fir Wood Ring, Alder Wood Ring, Yew Wood Ring, Ash Wood Ring).

entries.source: Allakhazam quest The Sylvan's Pain ('Live Per Patch 1.60'): 'Give the note to Sandu, and choose 2 from 11 level 49 rings ... Can not choose two of the same ring.'
entries.why: the ending gave ONE ring from 8 instead of two from the period 11: step 13 becomes the first choose step (Search) and a new step 14 the second (SearchFinish); the quest XP moves to step 14
